findings.description: AWS access key and secret key are hard-coded in plaintext as Lambda environment variables, exposing long-lived IAM credentials to anyone with read access to the Terraform state, source control, or Lambda console/API. This is a critical credential leak.
The function uses nodejs12.x, which is an end-of-life/deprecated Lambda runtime no longer receiving security patches, increasing exposure to known vulnerabilities.
